title: Ads
subtitle: Connect ad platforms, draft campaigns, and review performance from one place.

chart.title: Performance

chart.emptyHint: Figures stay empty until live ad-platform reporting is wired.

latest.subtitle: Drafts saved on this device until the ads API ships.
latest.emptyBody: Create a draft to try Ad management. Launching on Meta, Google, TikTok, or Snapchat is not available yet.

create.title: Create ad campaign
create.description: Saves a local draft only. Platform launch and billing are not connected yet.
create.name: Campaign name

management.emptyBody: Create a draft campaign to open the detail pane. Editing and launch to a live ad account come later.
management.draftBannerTitle: Finish this draft before you launch
management.draftBannerBody: Review the creative and budget in a later release. For now you can keep drafts on this device or delete them.

catalogDetail.meta: Catalog sync will appear here after Meta OAuth.
catalogDetail.google: Merchant Center link status after Google OAuth.
catalogDetail.tiktok: TikTok catalog feed after Events API setup.
catalogDetail.snapchat: Catalog feed sync after Snapchat OAuth.

benefitsIntro.meta: With Meta pixel and conversion events you get cleaner targeting and reporting.
benefitsIntro.google: With Google tag and conversion tracking you get accurate data to improve performance.
benefitsIntro.tiktok: With TikTok Pixel and the Events API you measure visits, carts, and purchases.
benefitsIntro.snapchat: With Snap Pixel and catalog sync you retarget shoppers who already know your store.

0.title: Know what works
0.body: Track visits, adds to cart, and purchases in one place so spend follows real outcomes.

1.title: A second chance to sell
1.body: Retarget people who saw an ad or left mid-checkout instead of starting cold every time.

2.title: Find lookalike audiences
2.body: Use your best customers as a seed once platform audiences are connected.

3.title: Let algorithms help
3.body: Hand platforms cleaner conversion signals so their bidding can optimise toward buyers.

integrations.footerHint: To finish setup later, launch a sales campaign after OAuth is available — that activates the pixel and catalog sync.

meta.title: Connect Meta to run smarter ads from here
meta.body: Link Facebook and Instagram ads so pixel events and catalog products stay in sync with this store.

google.title: Connect Google to run smarter ads from here
google.body: Link Google Ads and Merchant Center so conversions and product feeds stay accurate.

tiktok.title: Connect TikTok to run smarter ads from here
tiktok.body: Link TikTok Pixel and the Events API so catalog and conversion data stay trustworthy.

snapchat.title: Connect Snapchat to run smarter ads from here
snapchat.body: Link Snap Pixel and your catalog feed so product sets and conversions stay aligned.

snapchat.pixelHint: Paste the pixel ID from Snapchat Ads Manager. Saved on this device until the API exists.
snapchat.accountsHint: Ad accounts returned after OAuth will list here.
snapchat.catalogHint: Sync status for products pushed to Snapchat.
snapchat.setsHint: Optional subsets of the catalog for specific campaigns.
